stage_a2_dense_origin_pool.interpretation: [확인] original FORECAST failure is partly narrowed to sparse origin-pool design. [확인] this does not prove learned low-dimensional frozen-Bolt success.

stage_b_accuracy.interpretation: [확인] low-dimensional PRED improves over REC/PCA in several compressed comparisons and beats RAW_SELF_LAG on Robin, but it does not beat the strongest raw baselines under the bounded VAL diagnosis.

stage_b_cost.caveat: Latency includes preprocessing and inverse normalization but excludes model load/disk. VRAM/RSS are co-resident benchmark process measurements, not method-exclusive increments.

claims_to_avoid: [확인] Do not claim independent generalization: VAL was repeatedly used for development and TEST was protected.
[확인] Do not claim universal method failure or success: only two datasets, two nonlinear seeds, one K=floor(C/4), overlapping VAL windows.
[확인] Do not pool physical MSE across datasets or treat physical and normalized rankings as identical; Jena and Robin use heterogeneous channel units, and some physical/normalized rankings differ.
[확인] Do not say REC learned a useful codec under the selected criterion; Stage B REC selected update0 in the inspected nonlinear cases.
[확인] Do not make D-only causal claims from COMMON_D; E/D and correction effects are not causally isolated enough for that wording.
[확인] Do not treat native linear as a fair frozen-Bolt replacement at identical training conditions; native has extra trainable forecasting head and different cost semantics.
[확인] Do not report VRAM/RSS as method-exclusive memory savings.
recommended_next_action: No new experiments are required to close the experimental scope. Complete the integrated Korean report/figures and compute reader-facing time-block paired deltas from existing Stage B predictions/horizon metrics, then cite this scope audit and validation_final_v2.
